records.text: Owens said people who had been encouraged to enter the U.S. Capitol on January 6 were wrongly arrested.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And people were wrongly arrested, people who were encouraged to go into the Capitol on that day.

verification.notes: The source appearance was reviewed at 00:39:09. The assertion does not identify which arrested people, who encouraged them, or the legal basis for calling the arrests wrongful. Current official and court sources document varied conduct and charges, while the DOJ Inspector General found no FBI source was directed to encourage illegal acts. The broad, unspecified claim cannot be conclusively verified or falsified.
